note: E-commerce fraud protection (San Jose). 'In 2017, it raised $56 million in Series C funding led by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia). Mark: the $205M Series E of April 2021 at $1.34B, aligned with a16z and Menlo; stale beyond 24 months.
Omnichannel marketing platform (Kenshoo, renamed Skai in 2021; Tel Aviv, with offices in New York). BCV's listing: 2014, Growth. The round is not named.
Social shopping site (2011 Form D, Ajay Agarwal). The firm listed it in 2011-2013 only; no source read gives its fate. Graduation left for the graduation pass.

Identity verification (Incline Village, NV; the firm's listing still says New York). BCV's listing: 2021, Growth (Merritt Hummer), the year of the $100M Series D and the $450M Series E at $4.5B. Mark: the August 2026 round at $5.2B, aligned with Accel, fresher than the prefilled 2021 figure.

basis: SolarWinds' S-1 (2008-03-21): 'In December 2005, investors led by Bain Capital Ventures and Insight Venture Partners acquired an aggregate of 67.8% of our outstanding capital stock from our original stockholders and we recapitalized our company', with $110M of new debt. A majority recapitalisation by the firm and its co-investor group (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4). Insight's run excluded the same deal as a control position.

note: Virtual product photo and video shoots (Denver). 'BCV Leads $35M Investment In soona' ('we're so excited to lead the recent $35M Series B round', the firm's post, 2022-01-24); a Series B entry reads Growth. The 2023 filing is a later round.

Consumer electronics protection plans (San Francisco). 'SquareTrade announced today it has secured a $238 million growth equity investment lead by Bain Capital' (CNET, 2012-01-25), with Bain Capital Venture Fund 2009 beside Bain Capital Fund X (the 2012 securityholder agreement, Allstate's 8-K of 2016-11-28). Allstate bought it for $1.4B in January 2017 'from a group of shareholders, including Bain Capital Private Equity and Bain Capital Ventures'. OPEN for Erik: no source read states the 2012 ownership; the merger agreement's 'Contingent Consideration attributable to the Bain Capital Transaction' reads like acquisition accounting, which would make it a control position (D4).

Cloud monitoring as a service (Boston). 'Founded in 2012 ... and secured US$5 million in funding from Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia), the company's first institutional round, read as its Series A; Google acquired it in May 2014.

Real-time analytics on Apache Pinot (Mountain View). 'StarTree Secures $24 Million Funding' (GlobeNewswire, 2021-05-05): the seed and Series A BCV led at launch; the 2022 filing the band read is the $47M Series B.

Stream International, technical-support outsourcing (Richardson, TX, in the firm's 2006 listing, 'Expansion/Growth Buyout'). 'Stream was acquired by Solectron (NYSE: SLR) in October 2001' (the firm's 2012 page), so the entry predates that; the round is not named. The prefilled Italian country and 'defunct' came from a wrong Wikidata join, and the 2009 Form D joined to the row is Stream Global Services (Wellesley, MA; listed), a different company.

basis: SurveyMonkey: 'In 2009, Spectrum Equity and Bain Capital acquired a majority stake in the company' (Wikipedia); the vehicle was SM Holdco LLC, and Bain Capital Venture Fund 2007 signed the registration-rights agreement filed with SVMK's 2018 S-1. A control acquisition is not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4): the firm with its co-investor group took 50% or more.

SM Holdco LLC is the holding company of SurveyMonkey's 2009 recapitalisation (merges into 'surveymonkey'), which carried a majority stake bought by Spectrum Equity and Bain Capital (Wikipedia). This replaces the membership recorded for the merge. A control acquisition is not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4): the firm with its co-investor group took 50% or more.

note: Commerce-as-a-service for brands (San Francisco). The firm lists it as acquired. BCV's 2011 entry (Ajay Agarwal) sits in a company incorporated in 2010; the round is not named.
Autism blood test (Waltham, MA); a 2013 round with Google Ventures. BCV led its 2010 Series A filing (James Nahirny). The firm dropped it after 2013 and no source read gives its fate.

Cloud and container security (Draios, San Francisco). BCV's listing: 2013, Seed (Salil Deshpande, whose post names Sysdig among his open-source investments); Accel's Series A followed. Mark: the $350M Series G at $2.5B (December 2021), aligned with Accel and Insight, not the prefilled $1.18B; stale. Graduation left for the graduation pass (Draios' filings merge at the rebuild).

Talent management software (Recruitsoft, later Taleo; Dublin, CA). Bain Capital Venture Fund, L.P. held Recruitsoft from November 1999 (Taleo's S-1, 2004), the venture family's first vehicle (decisions.md D2). IPO 2005; Oracle bought it for $1.9B in 2012. The 1999 round is not named.

Mobile ad retargeting (New York). 'Twitter Confirms Acquisition Of Mobile Ad Retargeting Startup TapCommerce' (TechCrunch, 2014-06-30, https://techcrunch.com/2014/06/30/twitter-acquires-tapcommerce/). BCV's 2013 round is not named.
Ad personalisation for retailers (Burlingame). Twitter acquired it in 2015 (the firm's listing).
Regenerative medicine (East Norriton, PA, then Winston-Salem, NC). Bain Capital Venture Fund 2005 signed its investor rights agreement (S-1, 2009); IPO April 2010. The round BCV entered is not named.

Product search (Mountain View). 'In 2007, they received an additional $15 million in funding led by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia): a follow-on round after the 2006 launch financing, read as its Series B. Facebook acquired it in 2015.

Mobile entertainment (New York). Clear Channel acquired it in 2011 (Wikipedia). BCV's 2009 filing (Ajay Agarwal) sits in a company founded in 2004 with earlier rounds; the band is withheld and the round is not named.

Software-defined servers (Santa Clara). HPE acquired it in 2023 (https://www.futuriom.com/articles/news/hpe-adds-one-more-to-string-of-acquisitions/2023/03). BCV's listing gives 2014 (Enrique Salem); the 2018 filing the band read is a later round; the entry round is not named.
Embedded video API (San Francisco). 'July: Series B funding from Bain Capital Ventures and Sequoia Capital' (Wikipedia, 2008); a Series B entry reads Growth. Telefonica acquired it in October 2012.
Practice-management software and marketing for lawyers (Chicago). Acquired by Internet Brands (the firm's listing). BCV's 2012 round is not named.
Application performance tracing (Providence, RI). Acquired by AppNeta in 2012. Graduation left for the graduation pass.

Hotel revenue software (New York; Schaumburg, IL in the firm's 2003 listing). Genstar sold it to Thoma Bravo for $930M in 2014 and Amadeus bought it in 2018. BCV held it by 2003; the round is not named.

Online trust and background screening (Los Altos). 'Airbnb to Buy a Startup That Does Background Checks' (Fortune, 2017-06-16, https://fortune.com/2017/06/16/airbnb-trooly-background-checks/). BCV's 2015 round is not named.

Application resource management (VMTurbo, renamed Turbonomic; Boston). BCV backed it from its 2009 founding (the firm's listing; Ben Nye later became CEO), the company's first institutional round, read as its Series A; the 2019 filing the band read is a late round. IBM acquired it in June 2021 (Wikipedia).
Prepaid and payments processing platform (New York). Google acquired it in 2011 (the firm's listing).

LLM data preprocessing (San Francisco). The firm 'partnered at the seed' (its post, 2023-07-27); the Series A followed ('Unstructured Secures $25 Million in Seed and Series A Funding', businesswire, 2023-07-19), then a $40M Series B led by Menlo (2024). The 2023 filing the band read is the Series A.

basis: US LEC was listed on NASDAQ (CLEC) from 1998; Bain Capital's position was preferred stock in the listed company, held as a 10% owner (Bain Capital Investors, LLC's Form 4 of 2007-03-02, with Michael Krupka). A placement into a public company is not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3; decisions.md D4). PAETEC acquired US LEC in 2007.

note: Third-party risk management (Elizabethtown, KY). Ncontracts acquired it in September 2024 (https://finovate.com/ncontracts-acquires-third-party-risk-management-company-venminder/). BCV's round (listing: 2012) is not named.

Machine design and automation platform (Montreal). 'Our $13 million Series A investment in Montreal-based Vention' (the firm's post, 2019-01-15; 'in 2018, when we led the A round'). The prefilled US country was wrong.

Pharmacy and software for veterinary clinics (Portland, OR). 'We're excited to lead a $50 million investment in Vetsource' (the firm's post, 2018-06-05; FinSMEs calls it the Series D). Mars took a controlling stake in 2021 (https://news.vin.com/doc/?id\u003d10254890).
Voice analytics for sales coaching (San Francisco). 'We are excited to announce our Series A investment in VoiceOps' (the firm's post, 2019-08-27).

Consumer VoIP (Holmdel, NJ). Bain Capital Venture Fund 2005 held convertible preferred before the May 2006 IPO (its S-1): a late private round in a company founded in 1998, read as Growth. Ericsson acquired it in 2022 for $6.2B.
On-demand staffing marketplace (San Francisco); $138M in new funding in 2021. BCV entered at the 2018 Series C (Jamison Hill; 'Wonolo Raises $32M Series C', Crunchbase News, 2018-11-19).

World (Worldcoin), the proof-of-personhood network of Tools for Humanity (San Francisco), on Bain Capital Crypto's list. BCV entered at the $115M Series C led by Blockchain Capital (May 2023) and bought WLD tokens again in May 2025. Mark: the WLD token capitalisation, aligned with a16z's row. The 2009 Form D joined to the row (Alex Evans, issuer 'World') is a namesake filed twelve years before he joined BCV, so its Seed band is withdrawn.

Work management (San Jose). 'In October, 2013, Wrike secured $10 million in investment funding from Bain Capital' (Wikipedia; 'With $10M Bet From Bain Capital Ventures', Forbes), its first institutional round after a small angel seed, read as its Series A. Citrix bought it for $2.25B in 2021.
Cloud data integration (Tel Aviv). 'Xenon Ventures Buys Israeli Cloud Company Xplenty' (Calcalist, 2018-12-19). BCV's 2014 round is not named.

basis: Zelis: BCV's listing (2019, Growth, Matt Harris) is the 2019 combination of Zelis and RedCard under Parthenon Capital and Bain Capital ('Zelis, RedCard merge to form health care payments optimization platform', ROI-NJ, 2019-08-02), a sponsor-controlled merger, not a round (config verify.not_members). A control acquisition is not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4): the firm with its co-investor group took 50% or more.

note: Java developer tools (Tartu, Estonia; US office Boston). 'Seed funding of $0.38M in 2008/9 from Webmedia, and a Series A round in 2011 followed by further investment of $2.7M in January 2014, both led by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia); the 2013 filing the band read is the follow-on. Rogue Wave acquired it in 2017.

Dental referral service (Futuredontics, Los Angeles). The firm listed it in 2011-2013 (Paul Zurlo, Weston Gaddy); still operating in 2013 (new CEO). No source read gives the round, the stake or its later fate.

Robotic baby gear (Thorley Industries, Pittsburgh). UPPAbaby acquired it in July 2024 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/uppababy-expands-innovation-footprint-with-4moms-acquisition-302192510.html). BCV's 2012 round is not named.

401(k) platform for financial advisors. 'Aboon secures $17.5M seed funding' (InvestmentNews, 2025-10-16), with the firm's post the same day; inside 24 months, so censored. No source read places the company.
